history.meaning: Adapter and legacy Bridge tests before native fixture and cleanup refinements.
Fixture copied a reserved parent FD into child environment; corrected only the fixture, preserving product refusal.

Strict initial process-view check refused before any driver call. Concrete historical cause not recorded; no check weakened or product fix claimed. Later read-only identity instrumentation observed stable views.
Strengthened negative waits for natural child exit and observes exactly one driver/no later funding.
Normal context could succeed/discard handle without an authenticated exit observation.
Final exit guard and complete focused native/legacy/adapter selection; not added to full count as distinct tests.

invariants: The legacy identity-only path retains its original launcher arguments and publisher call.
Only the reserved strict startup marker selects the authenticated grant publisher; the low-level protocol still validates marker and original parent.
Exact Connection and SqlIntentRepository, canonical UUIDs, original worker/live control scope and canonical target are checked before Popen. Missing reservation refuses before launch.
A changed canonical realm in the child environment is refused at binding; mismatched role/TLS/path is refused by the opening guard before the driver.
Startup funding/commit precedes yield; subsequent requests use existing original-owner broker and held data budget. No thread, executor or global agent count introduced.
Failures after launch attach exact supervisor to the original exception; cleanup failures do not replace the primary exception.
A normal exit with no authenticated observation raises and retains the pinned handle instead of reporting success. Already-failing startup still joins/closes its unbound owned child when possible.
Process exit/EOF/context closure never refund held SQL charges or prove server backend absence.

peer_review.last_actionable_finding: Missing exit observation; reproduced RED, fixed and checked by lead.

limits: Caller must already own the live funded control scope, channel, prepared held data reservation and provisioned SQL4 journal; this does not establish root genesis or fund the first control TCP.
bridge_supervisor.main remains identity-only until an actual funded root/driver is provided. This is a controlled startup integration, not deployed CLI/global activation.

Caller scheduler must serve requests on the same original worker. Do not transfer Connection/supervisor to transient control callbacks or another executor; multiple children need readiness multiplexing, not per-agent threads.

Orderly shutdown must keep the caller broker service available while child cleanup needs SQL. The context fallback joins/signals its own child and preserves debt; it does not establish funded custody or successful generation sealing.
Private test instrumentation stops at runtime admission construction and substitutes native backend construction. No real HTTP/WebSocket/provider/model/network acceptance is claimed.
The historical early process-view refusal had zero driver calls; its precise transient cause was not captured. Stable-view final tests do not retrospectively explain it.
Mypy has eight preexisting imported-file errors under unchanged flags; baseline shadow-file check produced identical diagnostics. No global type-check PASS or suppressed diagnostics.
All ten original gates, root funding, complete inventory, independently funded custody, M1/M2/M3, quotas, SDK and UI remain open.
